// diagnostic

E0338

A cycle among computed-field formulas, including self-reference

What

A cycle among computed-field formulas, including self-reference

Why

A computed field's formula reads other fields, so the formulas must not depend on each other in a loop

Fix

Break the computed-field dependency cycle, including any self-reference.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0338: tests/ui/comptime_dependency_cycle_through_function.stderr.

Error [jet.ComputedFieldCycle]: Computed module fields form a cycle: FIRST -> SECOND -> THIRD -> FIRST
  --> tests/ui/comptime_dependency_cycle_through_function.jet:7:13
    |
  7 | FIRST: #run doubled_second()
    |             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Module-level comptime values must have a deterministic dependency order
 Fix: Break the cycle by making one value independent or by moving the shared computation into a pure function
